def solution():
    # Define variables
    starting_assets = 160.0
    growth_rate = 0.25
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.20
    hurdle_rate = 0.10
    prior_high_water_mark = 198.0

    # Calculate end-of-year assets and management fee
    end_of_year_assets = starting_assets * (1 + growth_rate)
    management_fee = end_of_year_assets * management_fee_rate

    # Calculate asset value after management fees
    net_assets = end_of_year_assets - management_fee

    # The net hurdle must be exceeded, and net assets must exceed the high-water mark
    hurdle_value = starting_assets * (1 + hurdle_rate)
    incentive_fee_base = max(0.0, net_assets - max(prior_high_water_mark, hurdle_value))
    incentive_fee = incentive_fee_base * incentive_fee_rate

    # Calculate total fees
    total_fees = management_fee + incentive_fee

    # Return answer rounded to one decimal place
    return round(total_fees, 1)
